run_interactive_3d_rendering: run interactive 3D rendering of an OBJ file with WASD camera controls and ESC to quit
render_scene_modes: render a 3D scene in RGB, semantic, instance, and depth modes and save as PNG images
create_render_api: create a RenderAPI instance with custom width, height, and GPU device for 3D rendering
load_3d_scene: load a 3D OBJ scene with model category and color configuration files into the render API
query_instance_from_color: query the instance name from an RGB color value using the render API
